sentences.text: Robert Chase , MBBS is a fictional character on the Fox medical drama House .	House	House (TV series)	MBBS	Bachelor of Medicine/Bachelor of Surgery	fictional character	fictional character	Fox	Fox network	medical drama	medical drama
He is portrayed by Jesse Spencer .	Jesse Spencer	Jesse Spencer
His character was a part of the team of diagnosticians who worked under Gregory House until the end of the third season when House fires him .	House	House (TV series)	Gregory House	Gregory House
However , he resumed work at the hospital as a surgeon , and was re-hired by House in season 6 .	House	House (TV series)
Robert Chase is the longest-serving member of House 's staff .	House	House (TV series)

Chase has been attracted to Allison Cameron since the beginning of the show and embarks on a romantic relationship with her in `` Human Error . ''	Allison Cameron	Allison Cameron (House)	Human Error	Human Error (House episode)
In `` Post Mortem , '' he left the Diagnostic Team after realizing he was in the same position as he was 10 years earlier , unlike all of the other former members of the team .

However , in the series finale , he rejoins the hospital as the new Head of Diagnostic Medicine , replacing House , who is thought to have died .	House	House (TV series)	Diagnostic Medicine	Diagnostics
